en: Black‑and‑white postcard. The front shows a modernist urban scene with a group of three elongated, stylized human statues standing on stones in a shallow pool, arms raised as if dancing. Behind them are mid‑20th‑century apartment blocks and, in the distant background, a hilly landscape with a church tower or dome rising above lower buildings. The back side has printed multilingual caption text describing a primary school on Móricz Zsigmond Square in Pécs, Hungary, a price line, publisher credit, postal markings, and handwritten Hungarian correspondence and address.
